text:
lara: heads-up from quarterly least-priv scan: found service account with projectEditor role in two prod projects. probable copy/paste from onboarding TF module. tagging eng-security. :alarm_clock:

nate: yikes. which SA + projects?

lara: sa: ci-runner@infra-svc. projects: redwood-prod-payments and redwood-prod-analytics. exported policy fragment attached.

ravi: can you paste the IAM change history for that SA? i want to see when the role was added. run a Cloud Audit logs query for SetIamPolicy & IAM policy delta.
lara: query i used:
```
resource.type="project"
protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy"
protoPayload.request.@type:"type.googleapis.com/google.iam.v1.SetIamPolicyRequest"
protoPayload.request.policy.bindings.members:"serviceAccount:ci-runner@infra-svc"
timestamp>="2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"
```
result: 2026-03-18T02:11:03Z by terraform@infra-cicd.gserviceaccount.com (PR #7710)

sec-bot: Alert INC-2026-57: unexpected privileged SA binding detected. Severity: high. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/priv-sweep

pooja: i'm taking lead. immediate plan: snapshot policy, do impact analysis (policy-simulator), scope or remove binding via emergency PR if blast radius confirmed, and add repo CI guard.

ravi: while pooja runs simulator, i'll enumerate resources the SA can access with current roles: list of compute instances, buckets, KMS keys, and service accounts. also check keys: any KMS key bound to project-level principals?

ops-bot: Noted: ci-runner@infra-svc used in 3 pipelines: infra-deploy, data-migration, nightly-backups. Last pipeline run with elevated perms: 2026-03-18T03:05Z.

pooja: simulator shows effective permission: resourcemanager.projects.update, storage.objects.delete, cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter. That maps to a destructive path if abused.

lara: payments team please confirm whether backups or migrations rely on projectEditor SA. @payments-eng

payments-eng (thread): payments flows: migration job uses a dedicated SA migration-pay@payments, not ci-runner. backups: uses snapshotter@ops. no direct reliance on ci-runner.

nate: ok looks like stale over-priv. propose emergency patch: remove projectEditor binding and replace with role/container.runner on the CI service accounts only. open PR and mark for fast-track.

pooja: opened emergency PR 7789 to remove the binding and add a scoped binding to serviceAccount:ci-runner@infra-svc with roles/iam.serviceAccountUser on the specific service accounts. CI failing tests pending; will run canary on dev project first.

ravi: while PR queued, rotate any long-lived keys the SA can access. especially KMS keys used by nightly-backups. run key usage logs for decrypt ops in last 7 days.

lara: found a decrypt call from pipeline infra-deploy at 2026-03-17T22:44Z using key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/deploy/cryptoKeys/deploy-key. recommend rotating that key and update pipelines to use rotated key material after testing.

payouts-eng: FYI payouts systems unaffected. thanks for the quick catch.

pooja: PR 7789 merged to prod canary, rolled to redwood-dev, smoke ok. rolling to prod in 10m during light traffic window. posting short maintenance note.

sec-bot: INC-2026-57 status: investigating -> mitigation in progress. assignee: pooja.

oncall: oncall approves emergency change. will monitor SLOs and watch for alerts.

nate: post-change checklist: 1) confirm absence of SetIamPolicy regressions 2) run policy-simulator again 3) audit logs rule: alert on any new project-level KMS or project-level compute role bindings 4) add a tflint rule to infra modules to forbid project-level editor/granter roles to SAs

pooja: done: added log-based alert for SetIamPolicy where binding.members contains "serviceAccount:ci-runner@infra-svc" AND binding.role matches "roles/editor|roles/owner|roles/compute". filed RFC-priv-schema to add policy-as-code and module linting. PR 7795 adds a tflint check and unit test to the TF modules.

lara: i archived the policy snapshot to secure GCS bucket and exported an evidence bundle for the postmortem. created INC-2026-57 postmortem stub.

ravi: one more follow-up: schedule quarterly entitlement sampling automation (random subset of SAs) to detect drift earlier. i'll draft a short automation in the sec-tooling repo.

pooja: incident closed after 4.5h. lessons: avoid project-level bindings in onboarding modules, enforce module variables for SA names, rotate keys when role changes, and add CI gates. i'll write full postmortem and action items.

lara: thanks team. small action: add a tiny test to infra pipeline that rejects PRs that touch project IAM policy files without an owner tag.

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-57 resolved. Timeline and artifacts: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-57

oncall: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
